name: pi-cloudflare-sandbox-workflows
description: Prototype-to-production spine for contextual Pi runs in Cloudflare Sandboxes.

scripts.prototype:spike:access:put: set -a; [ ! -f .env.local ] || . ./.env.local; set +a; test -n "$ACCESS_TOKEN" && printf '%s' "$ACCESS_TOKEN" | node prototypes/sandbox-workflow-spike/scripts/wrangler-with-cloudflare-token.mjs secret put ACCESS_TOKEN --config prototypes/sandbox-workflow-spike/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.prototype:joelclaw-swarm:brave:put: key="$(secrets lease brave-search-api 2>/dev/null || secrets lease brave_api_key)"; test -n "$key"; printf '%s' "$key" | node prototypes/joelclaw-research-swarm-spike/scripts/wrangler-with-cloudflare-token.mjs secret put BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY --config prototypes/joelclaw-research-swarm-spike/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.prototype:joelclaw-swarm:deploy: set -a; [ ! -f .env.local ] || . ./.env.local; set +a; (cd prototypes/joelclaw-research-swarm-spike && node scripts/wrangler-with-cloudflare-token.mjs queues create piwf-joelclaw-research-swarm-lanes || true) && (cd prototypes/joelclaw-research-swarm-spike && node scripts/wrangler-with-cloudflare-token.mjs deploy) && (test -z "$ACCESS_TOKEN" || printf '%s' "$ACCESS_TOKEN" | node prototypes/joelclaw-research-swarm-spike/scripts/wrangler-with-cloudflare-token.mjs secret put ACCESS_TOKEN --config prototypes/joelclaw-research-swarm-spike/wrangler.jsonc) && pnpm prototype:joelclaw-swarm:auth:put && pnpm prototype:joelclaw-swarm:brave:put
scripts.prototype:observability:deploy: set -a; [ ! -f .env.local ] || . ./.env.local; set +a; (cd prototypes/workflow-observability-spine-spike && node scripts/wrangler-with-cloudflare-token.mjs queues create piwf-observability-spine-lanes || true) && (cd prototypes/workflow-observability-spine-spike && node scripts/wrangler-with-cloudflare-token.mjs deploy) && (test -z "$ACCESS_TOKEN" || printf '%s' "$ACCESS_TOKEN" | node prototypes/workflow-observability-spine-spike/scripts/wrangler-with-cloudflare-token.mjs secret put ACCESS_TOKEN --config prototypes/workflow-observability-spine-spike/wrangler.jsonc) && pnpm prototype:observability:auth:put
scripts.prototype:parallel:deploy: set -a; [ ! -f .env.local ] || . ./.env.local; set +a; (cd prototypes/cloudflare-parallel-workflow-spike && node scripts/wrangler-with-cloudflare-token.mjs queues create piwf-parallel-lanes || true) && (cd prototypes/cloudflare-parallel-workflow-spike && node scripts/wrangler-with-cloudflare-token.mjs deploy) && (test -z "$ACCESS_TOKEN" || printf '%s' "$ACCESS_TOKEN" | node prototypes/cloudflare-parallel-workflow-spike/scripts/wrangler-with-cloudflare-token.mjs secret put ACCESS_TOKEN --config prototypes/cloudflare-parallel-workflow-spike/wrangler.jsonc)
scripts.prototype:registry:deploy: set -a; [ ! -f .env.local ] || . ./.env.local; set +a; (cd prototypes/cloudflare-registry-workflow-os-spike && node scripts/wrangler-with-cloudflare-token.mjs queues create piwf-registry-jobs || true) && (cd prototypes/cloudflare-registry-workflow-os-spike && node scripts/wrangler-with-cloudflare-token.mjs deploy) && (test -z "$ACCESS_TOKEN" || printf '%s' "$ACCESS_TOKEN" | node prototypes/cloudflare-registry-workflow-os-spike/scripts/wrangler-with-cloudflare-token.mjs secret put ACCESS_TOKEN --config prototypes/cloudflare-registry-workflow-os-spike/wrangler.jsonc)
scripts.prototype:capability:access:put: set -a; [ ! -f .env.local ] || . ./.env.local; set +a; test -n "$ACCESS_TOKEN" && printf '%s' "$ACCESS_TOKEN" | node prototypes/cloud-capability-lease-broker-spike/scripts/wrangler-with-cloudflare-token.mjs secret put ACCESS_TOKEN --config prototypes/cloud-capability-lease-broker-spike/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.prototype:capability:github:put: printf '%s' "$(secrets lease shitrat_github_app_id)" | node prototypes/cloud-capability-lease-broker-spike/scripts/wrangler-with-cloudflare-token.mjs secret put GITHUB_APP_ID --config prototypes/cloud-capability-lease-broker-spike/wrangler.jsonc && printf '%s' "$(secrets lease shitrat_github_installation_id_joelhooks)" | node prototypes/cloud-capability-lease-broker-spike/scripts/wrangler-with-cloudflare-token.mjs secret put GITHUB_APP_INSTALLATION_ID --config prototypes/cloud-capability-lease-broker-spike/wrangler.jsonc && printf '%s' "$(secrets lease shitrat_github_private_key)" | node prototypes/cloud-capability-lease-broker-spike/scripts/wrangler-with-cloudflare-token.mjs secret put GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY --config prototypes/cloud-capability-lease-broker-spike/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.prototype:capability:deploy: set -a; [ ! -f .env.local ] || . ./.env.local; set +a; (cd prototypes/cloud-capability-lease-broker-spike && node scripts/wrangler-with-cloudflare-token.mjs queues create piwf-capability-broker-jobs || true) && (cd prototypes/cloud-capability-lease-broker-spike && node scripts/wrangler-with-cloudflare-token.mjs deploy) && pnpm prototype:capability:access:put && pnpm prototype:capability:github:put
